Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our roadmap, we’re ready to hand off the implementation details to our Private Deploy team and schedule the on-prem kickoff. Attached are three artifacts to start: the VPC peering diagram you shared (annotated), our suggested appliance install manifest, and a short kickoff agenda.

A few immediate asks so we can finalize the timeline: 
- Confirm the external IP range you’ll use for the VPC peer (if you differ from the diagram).
- Confirm whether your on-prem appliance will be behind NAT or has a routable management interface.
- Please share the point of contact in your IT team for VPN/key provisioning (we referenced it-ops@argentum.ai).

Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff call (45 min) — we propose Wed 6/2 10:00am PT.
2) Network validation checklist run — owners: Argentum IT + Redwood networking.
3) Appliance delivery window — target the week of 6/14 after network validation.

If the times above don’t work, flag alternative slots and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Regards,

On it — I sketched the audit/export section and included three options: (1) Push to customer-managed S3 (AES-256 at rest), (2) SCP nightly to a customer host, (3) Real-time stream to SIEM via syslog over TLS. I’ll attach the snippet to the runbook and call out required firewall rules.

Two technical notes for kickoff: 
- If Argentum uses the 198.51.100.240/28 block as stated, we need to reserve .241-.242 for NAT translation on the appliance management plane. Confirm if those may be used.
- Appliance firmware v2.3.1 or later required for the new KV cache persistence; if they can’t upgrade prior to install, we’ll schedule a patch window post-install.
